mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6; methylprednisolone may induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing tolterodine levels, while additive anticholinergic effects may occur.
action: Monitor for reduced tolterodine efficacy and anticholinergic side effects; consider dose adjustment or alternative antimuscarinic if urinary symptoms worsen during corticosteroid therapy.
